title: Extraction and Protocol
author: Freya Fairweather
blurb: Ulyana Voss, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
